title: 第14章 红了，身边都是好人。

第14章 红了，身边都是好人。-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

“真的？”

老狼没想到好兄弟这么果断。

魏沐是个人才。

这一点，他非常肯定。

但用得着你这个老板亲自过来？

是不是有点太过重视.....

他和宋柯认识多年，对方是一个自视甚高的人，很少愿意这样放低身份。

“嗯，我们太合麦田就需要这样的人才。”

宋柯望着窗外的摩天大楼，那里来着一家又一家音乐公司。

别看现在太合麦田兵强马壮，有李宇春这样的超人气艺人，还有朴树这样的创作型艺人。

但是宋柯知道，太合麦田正处于转型的关键期。

人才越多，太合麦田这艘大船才能开得越稳，否则就会翻船。

只有不断扩充有实力的新人，才能让这家公司走得更远。

“还有，你以为只有太合麦田惦记着魏沐吗？”

电话那头沉默了一会，响起老狼疑惑的声音：“你是说，其他公司已经动手了？”

“当然。”

宋柯的想法没错，《体面》发布以后，魏沐确实受到了不少邀请。

这些邀请都被他一一拒绝。

理由很简单，给的条件不够好。

或者说，魏沐狮子大开口，让这些想要签约他的公司望而却步。

《体面》够火，可再火也只是一首歌而已。

在音乐公司眼里，魏沐只是一个有才气的创作型歌手。

然后呢？

一首歌能代表什么？

魏沐提的那些条件只有那些成名已久的歌手才有资格提出。

一个人刚出道没多久的新人凭什么呢？

“不好意思，我这边还是坚持自己的想法。”

拒绝了一家知名音乐公司，魏沐放下电话，他捏了捏有些疲惫的眉头。

没有红之前，总想着一夜爆红。

现在好了，爆红以后，他的电话就被打爆了。

就像第一次登上春晚的刘谦。

在那之前，他只是魔术师刘谦，在那之后，他则是登上春晚的魔术师刘谦。

两者差距，一个天一个地。

有次刘谦吐槽，疯狂的粉丝给他打电话，说自己已经破解了魔术的秘密。

抬头一看时间，夜里两点半。

“我是不是该换个手机号？”

"Really?"

Old Wolf didn't expect his good brother to be so decisive.

Wei Mu is a talent.

Of this, he was very sure.

But does it require you, the boss, to come in person?

Isn't it a bit too important...

He and Song Ke have known each other for many years. The other person is a person who thinks very highly of himself and is rarely willing to lower his status like this.

"Well, we in Taihe wheat field need such talents."

Song Ke looked out the window at the skyscrapers, where one music company after another came.

Don't look at Taihe Maitian's current strength, with super popular artists like Li Yuchun and creative artists like Pu Shu.

But Song Ke knew that Taihe Wheatfield was in a critical period of transformation.

The more talents there are, the more steadily the big ship of Taihe Wheatfield can sail, otherwise it will capsize.

Only by continuously recruiting new and talented people can this company go further.

"Also, do you think Taihe Maitian is the only one who cares about Wei Mu?"

There was silence for a while on the other end of the phone, and then Lao Lang's confused voice sounded: "You mean, other companies have already taken action?"

"Of course."

Song Ke was right. After the release of "Decent", Wei Mu did receive many invitations.

All these invitations were rejected by him.

The reason is simple: the conditions given are not good enough.

In other words, Wei Mu opened his mouth so loudly that the companies that wanted to sign him were put off.

"Decent" is popular enough, but no matter how popular it is, it's just a song.

In the eyes of the music company, Wei Mu is just a talented singer-songwriter.

Then what?

What can a song represent?

Only singers who have been famous for a long time are qualified to put forward the conditions Wei Muti raised.

Why should a newcomer who has just debuted?

"Sorry, I still stick to my own ideas."

After rejecting a well-known music company, Wei Mu put down the phone and pinched his tired brows.

Before becoming famous, I always wanted to become famous overnight.

It's fine now. After becoming famous, his phone number was flooded with calls.

Just like Liu Qian who attended the Spring Festival Gala for the first time.

Before that, he was just the magician Liu Qian, and after that, he was the magician Liu Qian who appeared on the Spring Festival Gala.

The gap between the two is one of heaven and one of earth.

Liu Qian once complained that crazy fans called him and said that he had cracked the secret of magic.

I looked up at the time, it was half past two at night.

"Should I change my phone number?"
